findings.summary: The entry documents its stdout contract as "输出恒为单个机器可解析 JSON" (src/deep-research-entry.ts:29), but both non-dry-run branches write their routing/prepared JSON and then spawn the child with stdio:"inherit", so the heavy loop's `[deep-research-loop] mode=...` and drain output (and any light workflow.js output) land on the same stdout. A consumer of the MCP tool surface that does JSON.parse(stdout) succeeds only on --dry-run and fails on every real launch. The mcp-tool declaration specifies no output schema, so the source comment is the only stated contract and it is inaccurate for the paths that matter.

Deliverable 6(c) is pinned only through --dry-run: both fail-closed assertions run the heavy path with --dry-run --profile local, and the one non-dry-run heavy test uses the green agent-harness profile. Nothing asserts that a red preflight on a real (non-dry-run) start creates no channels and spawns no loop. The current code is safe because the single preflight gate at :246 precedes both the dry-run branch and the channel/loop work, and moving the dry-run branch above it would turn the existing test red -- so this is a coverage nit, not a live defect.

Verification scope: with read-only file inspection I could not execute the prescribed `git diff --exit-code fe641b5a.. c1e950e2.. -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'`, so I neither confirm nor refute it and report no diff blocker in either direction. I did confirm from the worktree's detached-HEAD file that the reviewed tree is c1e950e29bf360bb4d7da7d73273f04c248e3fea, and the only attempt-scoped .dev-dispatch content present is the RC review artifact, the implement handoff, and the feedback index -- consistent with a metadata-only materialization. Separately, the committed implement handoff records work_head_commit eb446092a34286e3f0168bf0a25a01fbb2234b63 and input_commit 777826af478b249ef99909bee6f0393d9d0c8869, which differ from the dispatch context's fe641b5a.../c1e950e2...; the same offset appeared in attempts 1 and 2 and is expected if the handoff is written before it is committed, but confirming it needs Git access I do not have.
